mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 35 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a New Moon visible.

City crews are focusing on road maintenance this Tuesday and Wednesday. Work includes milling near North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, followed by paving the next day. Please clear your cars from these areas between 7 AM and 7 PM.
Join us today for Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead, tomorrow is busy with trivia options at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's.
On October 25, local officers handled a situation where a driver was found stationary at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, which resulted in an arrest for O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Georgia Peach. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy a scoop.
